Rather than dump everything, let me narrow it down — what date are you considering and roughly how many guests?

Quick highlights while you think it over:
- Weekday: $180/hr (4-hr min); Weekend: $260/hr (5-hr min); full-day buyout $2,400 weekday / $3,600 weekend
- Setup/teardown: 1 hour before and after, free
- AV (projector, 2 mics, Sonos) included
- Open dates in October so far: 10/3, 10/10, 10/17 (Sat), plus most weekdays

On cancellations and discounts — I don't have specifics on those in what I can confirm, so I don't want to guess. I can get our events manager to send you the exact cancellation terms and any current promotions — they'll email you today. Once I know your date and headcount, I can also give you a more precise cost estimate.
